assumptions.text: SpeakX is an English-speaking practice app; Sia is its AI coach. Supplied brief targets Indian learners approximately16–50, Pre-A1–B1+, with interviews, workplace and everyday use cases.
Only https://x.com/SpeakxOnX/ identifies a specific account. instagram.com/,facebook.com/,youtube.com/shorts/ are generic landing pages, not brand-account identities.
90-day native exports, team availability, budget, prices, trial terms, app URLs, conversion event schema, current offers, paid/organic split, approved Cartesia voice and video-provider capabilities.

Use Hindi/Hinglish first, geographically inclusive examples, one concept per episode, original Sia-only scripts. Regional content requires a fluent reviewer; never infer language preference solely from city.
Native channel publishing targets are operating goals, not forecasts. No promised follower/revenue number or industry benchmark without a baseline.
Organic-only; no advertising spend. October1–30 scope. Commercial rights for Sia confirmed. Kie API key and Cartesia Sia voice ID will be supplied later; generation integration remains unconfigured.

speakx.ai lists interview, higher-study, travel, promotion and family use cases and seven native languages. Actual current price/trial/deep links require verification. Do not repeat homepage outcomes as independently established results.

positioning.master: SpeakX helps Indian learners turn English they understand into sentences they can say: practise one real-life moment with Sia, then continue guided speaking practice in the app when that capability is verified.
positioning.promise: One useful sentence. One safe place to try. One next step.
whiteSpaceHypotheses: Own practice completion rather than endless phrase consumption: give viewers two seconds to speak before Sia models the answer.
Build location-linked micro-missions: interview reception, team stand-up, clinic desk, railway counter; illustrated maps create continuity without claiming physical visits.
Treat Indian multilingual identity as useful context, not a deficit. Teach intelligibility rather than accent erasure.
Make beginner, fresher and working-professional versions visibly distinct; avoid one feed where every post assumes the same level.
Demonstrate the exact in-app continuation of a social lesson only after product verification.
unfairAdvantages: Supplied consistent Sia character board and brand assets can create a recognizable series.
Illustrated city-map library can organize contextual lessons.
An app can potentially connect practice to repeat usage; actual lesson/deep-link capabilities require confirmation.
notYetProven: Competitor content gaps at account level

visualAndVoice.sia: Same approved face, hair, grey outfit and Cartesia voice ID; only Sia visible/audible. Interviewer and learner roles are silent text cards. No visible founder, street respondent or invented learner testimonial.
visualAndVoice.hook: No greeting or logo-first delay. First frame states the exact situation; promise payoff by second5.
visualAndVoice.text: Two caption lines maximum; target word highlight; charcoal/white contrast and supplied orange accent; safe zones verified on each native preview.
visualAndVoice.thumbnail: Sia plus3–5 words: situation + benefit; examples: Interview intro, Ask politely, Start your answer. Avoid fake shocked expressions.
visualAndVoice.caption: First line names the task; one teaching takeaway; one action. Mark incorrect English clearly, distinguish grammatical alternatives from stylistic preferences.
visualAndVoice.replyPersonality: Warm and precise: Good start. Try “I am interested in...” for this sentence. Never mock accent or demand public disclosure.

measurementPolicy.cohorts: Compare same platform, format, observation age, organic status and similar duration; mature at72h for operational view,7days for decisions; evergreen search also30days.
measurementPolicy.baseline: At least10mature comparable posts before a median index; median0 disables ratio. Index100 is own baseline, not industry quality.
measurementPolicy.crossPlatform: Show platform panels; sum counts only as gross events with duplicate-audience warning, never unique total reach.
measurementPolicy.index: primary_metric / matched_cohort_median ×100;130/70 triage thresholds are configurable heuristics, not significance.
measurementPolicy.privacy: Keep only consented first-party identifiers; suppress small demographic groups per source constraints.

recommendationAllocation.coldStart: No proven patterns yet: treat all initial hypotheses as unproven and use a balanced curriculum. Introduce exploit labels only after repeated mature evidence.

instagram.periodLabel: Last 30 days, excluding today; exact calendar range not captured
instagram.distribution: Mixed: Instagram Info explicitly includes ads; organic share unknown
instagram.interpretation: An aggregate same-period ratio, not a deduplicated user funnel. No paid subscriptions, revenue, retention curve or organic-only reach verified.
instagram.scopeWarning: Top-content visible cards show much smaller counts than the account total; reconcile account/ad/content scopes before attributing performance.

facebook.ownerAnalytics: Not exposed in current personal-profile view

strategicUpdate.stage: Instagram and Facebook are established audiences; X is a small account. Do not treat all channels as a zero-audience launch.
strategicUpdate.firstPriority: Build repeatable Sia practice series and measure organic-only reach, saves, qualified viewers and downstream intent.
strategicUpdate.conversionTest: Profile-to-link path: clarify speaking outcome and match pinned post to approved landing page. Current mixed-scope link-taps/profile-visits ratio is1.758%; do not claim a unique-person conversion rate.
strategicUpdate.brandConsistency: IG says15mins/day;FB andX say10mins/day. Align to an approved product usage promise; no guaranteed fluency.
strategicUpdate.noPaidAction: Existing ad activity was observed; no ads were created or changed. This campaign remains organic-only.
